title: NoBeefSteaks
description: NoBeefSteaks is a mod that applies negative effects when someone tries to eat beef.
body:
# No Beef Steaks
NoBeefSteaks is another basic mod that applies many negative status effects with maximum amplifiers when an entity attempts to eat raw beef or steak.  
This is actually an extension to my other NoPorkChops mod which you can view on my page!

### Features
**This is an extreme exaggeration of the prohibition of killing or eating cows in Hinduism as it is considered sacred in many cultures.**  
It gives the following effects for 27 seconds at their maximum survival level with the normal ticks per second:
- Bad Omen: Level 5  
- Unluck: Level 3  
- Weakness: Level 1  
- Mining Fatigue: Level 3  
- Wither: Level 2  
- Levitation: Level 5  
- Slowness: Level 4  
- Poison: Level 2  
- Hunger: Level 3  
- Blindness: Level 1  
- Darkness: Level 1  
- Nausea: Level 1  

### Versions
This mod / datapack supports many Minecraft versions. Pick out the specific mod release for your major update accordingly.
